method: Endpoints were selected by literal SQL pattern matching on method and path, never by running the retrieval engine under test. Labelling from search output would be circular and would flatter whichever ranker produced it.
relevance: Binary. An endpoint is relevant when it genuinely performs the requested operation, regardless of provider. Several providers are often correct for one query - 'create an issue' is satisfied by GitHub, Bitbucket and Jira alike - and marking only one would penalise a ranker for being right in a way the label did not anticipate.
